annotations.title: Payout rules: does it apply, and when

description: Which payout rules reach a payout, and when: for a corridor (two-letter countries, or currencies) and a route (bank or stablecoin), each rule SwapEazi holds answers applies, depends (and on what) or does not apply, with its dated steps, its official document and the day it was read. Drafts are never answered as law. Information from each rule's own document, not legal advice. route_intent carries the rules that reach its payout in its rules field. Read-only, free, no key.
